GRADE 6 SOCIAL STUDIES — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 48 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify minerals found in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U completely.
   C. Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U.

2. About Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the methods of extracting minerals in Eastern Africa
   B. Learners should ignore Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U completely.
   C. Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U.

3. About Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the effects of smining on the environment in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U completely.
   C. Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U.

5. About Traditional forms of Government in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe traditional forms of government of the Buganda and the Nyamwezi in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Traditional forms of Government completely.
   C. Traditional forms of Government is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Traditional forms of Government.

6. About Traditional forms of Government around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. compare traditional forms of government of the Buganda and the Nyamwezi,
   B. Learners should ignore Traditional forms of Government completely.
   C. Traditional forms of Government is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Traditional forms of Government.

7. About Traditional forms of Government in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe traditional forms of government of the Buganda and the Nyamwezi in Eastern Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Traditional forms of Government completely.
   C. Traditional forms of Government is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Traditional forms of Government.

9. About Regional co- operations in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the objectives of East African Community,
   B. Learners should ignore Regional co- operations completely.
   C. Regional co- operations is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Regional co- operations.

10. About Regional co- operations around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the benefits of the East African Community to member states,
   B. Learners should ignore Regional co- operations completely.
   C. Regional co- operations is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Regional co- operations.

11. About Regional co- operations in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the objectives of East African Community,
   B. Learners should ignore Regional co- operations completely.
   C. Regional co- operations is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Regional co- operations.

13. About Citizenship in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the rights and responsibilities of a Kenyan citizen,
   B. Learners should ignore Citizenship completely.
   C. Citizenship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Citizenship.

14. About Citizenship around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. state the qualities of a good Kenya citizen,
   B. Learners should ignore Citizenship completely.
   C. Citizenship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Citizenship.

15. About Citizenship in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate the values of a good Kenyan citizen,
   B. Learners should ignore Citizenship completely.
   C. Citizenship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Citizenship.

17. About Human rights in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain classification of human rights in society,
   B. Learners should ignore Human rights completely.
   C. Human rights is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Human rights.

18. About Human rights around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe ways in which human rights are upheld in society,
   B. Learners should ignore Human rights completely.
   C. Human rights is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Human rights.

19. About Human rights in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate ways in which human rights are upheld in society,
   B. Learners should ignore Human rights completely.
   C. Human rights is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Human rights.

21. About Government Revenue and Expenditure in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify sources of revenue for National Government in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Government Revenue and Expenditure completely.
   C. Government Revenue and Expenditure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Government Revenue and Expenditure.

22. About Government Revenue and Expenditure around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain ways in which the national and county governments in Kenya spend their revenue,
   B. Learners should ignore Government Revenue and Expenditure completely.
   C. Government Revenue and Expenditure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Government Revenue and Expenditure.

23. About Government Revenue and Expenditure in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify key words in the preamble of the Constitution of Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Government Revenue and Expenditure completely.
   C. Government Revenue and Expenditure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Government Revenue and Expenditure.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Mining in Eastern Africa - Soda ash in Kenya - Gold in Tanzania - Limestone in U in your school compound.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Traditional forms of Government in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Regional co- operations in your school compound.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Citizenship in your school compound.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Human rights in your school compound.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Government Revenue and Expenditure in your school compound.
